summary: Iteration 123: Unpublish Listing Feature Testing. All 9 backend tests passed. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 123 tested the unpublish listing feature. Key findings: (1) POST /api/listings/{listing_id}/unpublish works correctly - sets active/paused listings to draft status. (2) Endpoint rejects: already-draft listings (400), non-existent listings (404), unauthorized requests (401). (3) Search endpoint filters by status='active' so draft listings are excluded from public search. (4) GET /api/seller/listings returns all seller's listings including drafts. (5) Publish endpoint requires GST verification (expected behavior per agent context). (6) Frontend has correct implementation: handleToggleStatus in page.tsx, handleUnpublish in [id]/page.tsx, unpublishSellerListing API function. (7) Toggle buttons have data-testid attributes for testing. (8) Frontend builds without errors.
